metadata.purpose: Quiet labels and supporting status details at 12px.

data.purpose: Timestamps, counts, IDs, and execution values at 12px.

motion.name: activity-pulse
motion.purpose: Current-activity icons only; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Command Wordmark
components.description: Application identity is the POMEGR wordmark only; no pomegranate icon is paired with it.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { width: 76px; height: 22px; display: block; color: var(--ink); } .ds-wordmark svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 13; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-wordmark:hover { color: var(--green); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Global Search
components.description: A compact destination search with an optional keyboard shortcut hint.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input placeholder="Search dashboards, sessions, and agents" aria-label="Search Pomegr destinations"><kbd>Ctrl K</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--muted); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-search svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); } .ds-search kbd { padding: 3px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-data), Consolas, monospace; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Rail Item
components.description: Selected route in the desktop rail; labels collapse at compact widths and return inside the mobile off-canvas drawer.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-active { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: var(--brand); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--panel); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Pomegranate action for supported operations; unavailable actions are disabled rather than simulated.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--brand); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--command-brand); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--brand); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Quiet bordered action for route-level navigation or supported secondary work.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--panel-2); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Signal Panel
components.description: Flat operational evidence surface with one-pixel boundary and semantic value color.
components.html:
All-agent contextCurrent snapshot
1M

components.css: .ds-signal-panel { min-height: 142px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); } .ds-signal-panel header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; } .ds-signal-panel strong { font: 650 16px/1.35 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-signal-panel header span, .ds-signal-panel p { color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-signal-panel b { display: block; margin-top: 16px; color: var(--blue); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-data), Consolas, monospace; } .ds-signal-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.css: .ds-notification-tray { width: 390px; max-width: calc(100vw - 28px); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--popover-shadow); } .ds-notification-tray header { min-height: 60px; padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-notification-tray h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 16px/1.35 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-notification-tray p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-notification-tray button { min-width: 32px; min-height: 32px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); } .ds-notification-tray button:hover { border-color: var(--line); color: var(--ink); } .ds-notification-tray button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-notification-group { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-data), Consolas, monospace; } .ds-notification-tray article { min-height: 80px; padding: 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-notification-tray article i { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); } .ds-notification-tray strong { font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-notification-tray article a { color: var(--brand); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-notification-tray time { color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-data), Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Settings Row
components.description: Flat preference row pairing an effect description with a native switch or bounded state label.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-setting-row { min-height: 76px; padding: 0 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); } .ds-setting-row strong, .ds-setting-row span { display: block; } .ds-setting-row strong { font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-setting-row div > span { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-coming { padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-data), Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Agent Activity Control
components.description: A compact evidence control beside an agent title on wide screens and on its own line at 640px or less.
components.html: Primary agent
components.css: .ds-agent-title { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; gap: 7px 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 590 12px/1.25 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-agent-activity { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-agent-activity:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); background: var(--panel); } .ds-agent-activity:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-agent-activity { flex-basis: 100%; } }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-coming-soon { min-height: 134px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); } .ds-coming-soon > span { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-data), Consolas, monospace; } .ds-coming-soon h2 { margin: 12px 0 0; font: 500 16px/1.35 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-coming-soon p { max-width: 72ch; margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-ui), sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Pomegr is a local-first, read-only observer that makes coding-agent activity legible without exposing the underlying conversation. The application is a calm evidence workspace: a compact wordmark header, persistent route rail, flat panels, one-pixel rules, and restrained semantic color give the operator a reliable scan order. The approved HTML preview in `docs/design/pomegr-ui-preview.html` is the code-led authority for this application refresh; no generated component or seed is required.

The application shell keeps its identity provider-neutral and preserves the existing normalized content, privacy boundary, and metric semantics. Landing/marketing remains independently scoped and may retain its own typography and brand treatments; do not promote landing decisions into the app shell.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal dark mode with light neutral mode using the same layout and semantic roles.
Inter for all UI hierarchy; Geist Mono for data and execution metadata.
Flat evidence surfaces with 4px controls, 6px panels, and restrained borders.
A 60px header and 220px desktop rail, with compact and mobile adaptations.
Neutral idle states; semantic error red is reserved for actual error states.
Provider-neutral, read-only language and honest unavailable/coming-soon states.

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, lavender, and error communicate recorded state. Neutral styling represents idle, unavailable, and ordinary resting states; semantic error is never used as decoration.

rules.name: The Two Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Inter for interface language and Geist Mono for data. Landing typography is a separate surface decision.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Panels, tables, metrics, and settings panes use tone and rules instead of decorative floating shadows.

dos: Do use the committed tokens in `app/styles/tokens.css` as the source of truth.
Do use Inter at 26px titles, 16px sections, 14px UI/body, 13px controls, and 12px metadata; use Geist Mono for numeric and execution data.
Do preserve the 60px header, 220px desktop rail, 36px default controls, 32px compact controls, and 44px touch targets.
Do preserve wordmark-only provider-neutral identity, normalized privacy boundaries, and existing metric semantics.
Do keep context history before request snapshots and explain their separate meanings accurately.
Do keep landing typography, paper artifacts, and brand decisions scoped to landing/marketing.
donts: Don't reintroduce Rokkitt, square application geometry, nearly-black legacy token names, or landing typography as app-shell guidance.
Don't use semantic colors for decoration; reserve semantic error for actual errors and keep idle states neutral.
Don't expose prompts, responses, commands, credentials, raw transcript content, or unsupported provider detail.
Don't turn context history into throughput, spend, or cumulative usage; don't aggregate request snapshots.
Don't replace unavailable evidence with fake activity, counts, controls, or success states.
